Me and my husband have just returned from a weeks stay here at Ramada in Bodrum. I have never felt the need to write a review but thought I needed to. Pros- The views from our room were amazing, over looking the sea. The sunsets were beautiful. Room clean. Some staff polite and work tirelessly. Pool lovely and clean. Weather amazing. The Jet2 rep Omar, was very helpful- the first day my hubby lost his phone and he tried to help him find it. The cons- The hotel was packed as it was still Turkish school holidays, note to one’s self always check before. The queues into the restaurant were ridiculous, everyone pushing and shoving in front of you, no manners. Food was average- we’re normally not picky eaters. The food at the pool bar was left out from early morning all day. The al-carte experience was poor, the food was the same at the hotel restaurant only good thing was you didn’t have to stand in the crazy queues. Sun beds hard to find, everyone puts their towels on early and then don’t appear half the day. The music round the pool was so loud all day, you couldn’t hear yourself think. We’re not an old couple 40’s but wow….. The entertainment team work hard but found some quite unprofessional. One of the days they had a foam party and one of them was stood on the hand rails to the steps, diving in when people were stood there. It was packed. Health and safety out the window. I’d of been frightened to death if I had young kids. Kids club went on and on until quite late at night. I ended up with a stomach bug on the 2nd day, so was unable to leave the hotel in fear of needing the toilet, I’m still the same now. 7 days in total. After speaking to a few English people they were the same. This ruined my holiday. I’m not quite sure why none of these complaints have been addressed as you seem to respond with we will look into this. Some of the same complaints dating back are from 2016 with the same issues. I could go on and on. I’m not saying avoid this hotel just be wary. Claire
